description: A ground-level photograph depicts an aquaculture landscape, specifically showing highly transformed and controlled freshwater ponds, likely used for fish farming. A prominent, narrow, grassy embankment with a central dirt path extends into the distance, separating two distinct bodies of calm water. The water bodies feature some emergent vegetation along their edges, particularly on the right side. In the background, a dense line of trees forms a forest edge, with a small white structure and a green object visible near the treeline. The sky is bright and overcast. The bottom left corner of the image contains the attribution: "© B. Zywert/LUCAS, 2009".
